# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Reviewed the latest approved validation findings for the save-schema/versioning work and made no additional code changes. The remaining note was the pre-existing `Engine::step_hours` mutation-on-error issue, which is unrelated to this deliverable, so `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/actions.rs`, `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs`, and `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_population.rs` were left unchanged while focused validation was rerun successfully.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the latest review output and rechecked the save-schema and shrimp-test touch points to confirm whether any new actionable fixes were requested.
2. [Skipped] Apply additional code changes for newly requested fixes.
3. [Completed] Reran focused validation covering the save-load migration path, shrimp population tests, and `tank_core` test-target clippy after confirming this apply-fixes pass was a no-op.

## Validation Evidence

- `git diff --stat -- crates/tank_core/src/types/actions.rs crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_population.rs crates/tank_core/src/save.rs` returned no changes, confirming this apply-fixes pass did not modify the previously touched files.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load` passed: 18 tests passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_population` passed: 10 tests passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core --tests -- -D warnings` passed with no warnings.

## Outstanding Risks

- Known unrelated architectural issue carried forward from prior review: `Engine::step_hours` still calls `enforce_invariants(&mut self.state)` before returning some invariant errors, so a rejected step can still mutate live state.
